conditional_state_quality.interpretation: The fixed local state-vector convention produced a reproducible conditional expected-cut increase on two bounded n=10 graph samples.

complete_procedure_performance.interpretation: Conditional state quality did not translate into better end-to-end best-cut performance under the declared shot budget.

limitations: Exact state-vector simulation does not identify physical runtime, hardware noise, queueing or measurement overhead.
The graph family, fixed beta/gamma, pair rule and alternating assignment are narrow and not a population or asymptotic claim.
The original A2 action failed its n=8 setup gate and was not retrospectively rewritten.
The result is a reproduction/bounded extension; no new theorem, quantum advantage or planner superiority is established.
novelty_boundary: The conditional effect is treated as a reproduction of a source-style construction plus a bounded extension, not as a novel discovery.
next_action: Do not repeat QAOA without a substantively new cost or state-preparation hypothesis and a new explicit local authorization.
